description: Regression scenarios for Codex YWC language configuration scope handling, language normalization, and session-scope rejection.

evals.name: project-scope-normalizes-language-alias
expected_behavior: Announces that it is configuring the Codex YWC output-language default.
Normalizes the language alias `korean` to the canonical code `ko`.
States the target path `.codex/ywc.json` and writes exactly `{ "lang": "ko" }`.
Verifies the file exists, is valid JSON, and has an allowed `.lang` value.
anti_behavior: Leaving the language value as the alias `korean` instead of `ko`.

evals.name: user-scope-normalizes-non-english-alias
expected_behavior: Normalizes the language alias `日本語` to the canonical code `ja`.
States the target path `~/.codex/ywc.json` before writing.
Creates the parent directory when needed and writes exactly `{ "lang": "ja" }`.
Reports the completed scope, path, and canonical language code.
anti_behavior: Using `jp` or `japanese` as the persisted language code.
Adding session-specific or temporary config files.
Skipping post-write JSON and language-code verification.

evals.name: session-scope-is-rejected-without-writing
expected_behavior: Rejects session scope and stops without writing any file.
Explains that session defaults are intentionally out of scope.
Explains that conversation language follows the user's current language naturally.
Points to the durable artifact language resolution policy.
anti_behavior: Treating session scope as project scope.
Asking for a different scope after already receiving `--scope session`.

evals.name: unsupported-language-asks-for-correction
expected_behavior: Recognizes that `fr` is not one of the supported canonical codes or aliases.
Asks for a corrected value from `ko`, `ja`, `en`, `zh`, or `es` before writing.
Does not create or modify the target config file until a supported language is provided.
Keeps the requested project scope available for the corrected language value.
anti_behavior: Inventing a new supported language code.
Writing a partial or invalid JSON config while waiting for correction.
